name: Alvimopan after radical cystectomy
question: Does perioperative alvimopan accelerate gastrointestinal recovery compared with placebo after radical cystectomy?

design.population: Patients undergoing radical cystectomy who were scheduled to receive postoperative intravenous opioid patient-controlled analgesia.
design.locator: Lee 2014, PubMed abstract, Design, setting, and participants and Results; Kauf 2014, PubMed abstract, Purpose

verdictNote: GI-2 recovery was faster with alvimopan.
takeaway: Oral alvimopan versus placebo accelerated GI-2 recovery after radical cystectomy (5.5 versus 6.8 days; HR 1.8, p < 0.0001) and shortened mean hospital stay in the randomized trial.

reports.label: Economic analysis
reports.citation: Kauf TL, Svatek RS, Amiel G, et al. "Alvimopan, a peripherally acting μ-opioid receptor antagonist, is associated with reduced costs after radical cystectomy: economic analysis of a phase 4 randomized, controlled trial." *J Urol.* 2014;191(6):1721-1727. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2013.12.015
reports.followUp: Index hospital stay and postoperative ileus-related readmissions

results.measure: Mean cost difference per patient, alvimopan minus placebo, using 2012 Medicare reimbursement and wholesale drug costs
results.note: Cost-consequence analysis; not a clinical endpoint. Bootstrap comparison.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and methods and Results

results.measure: Mean cost difference per patient, alvimopan minus placebo, using 2012 Medicare reimbursement and wholesale drug costs
results.note: The bootstrap comparison did not meet conventional statistical significance.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and methods and Results

results.measure: Time to both first solid-food tolerance and first bowel movement, days
results.note: Modified intention-to-treat population: 277 of 280 randomized; arm-specific analysis denominators were not in the abstract.

results.note: Mean difference in days, alvimopan minus placebo, calculated from reported group means.
